risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and strongly quantified, showing substantial year-over-year improvement in sales, operating profit, net income and Adjusted EBITDA, as well as available borrowing capacity and covenant compliance. Risk remains from inflation, supply-chain disruption, labor shortages, and rising input, transportation, energy and labor costs. Extensive non-GAAP adjustments and highly technical definitions may complicate comparability with reported results.
